messages:
Maya P.: Heads up — Northbridge renewal: they want an addendum to migrate to the new seat model. Procurement asked for a signed license addendum before 2026-04-15. Onboarding flagged SSO mapping as blocked; that will delay seat activation if we miss sign date. Need pricing confirmation + legal path.

Jorge R.: On it. Are we keeping the same per-seat price for migrated seats? I thought we agreed to keep existing customer pricing for the 5 legacy seats. I can push the addendum today but want to confirm SKU mapping.

Priya N.: Quick Q — which license template are we using (standard addendum or bespoke)? I need the legal entity name + billing entity to prepare. If you drop the doc to Drive I can pre-review.

Maya P.: Link to draft: https://drive.redwood/mock/northbridge_addendum_v1 (internal). They also asked to switch to monthly billing instead of upfront — finance needs to weigh in.

Eli C.: Monthly billing is OK only for net30 netted accounts. Customer PO says net15. If they insist on monthly, revenue ops approval required. What's the ARR and exact seat count?

Maya P.: ARR ~ $48k, 25 seats total. We're migrating ~5 legacy seats with proration. Onboarding team says SSO mapping will take ~2 weeks after signature. Customer wants go-live by 2026-05-01.

Jorge R.: If signature slips past 4/15, go-live is at risk. I'll offer a parallel enablement plan (stub SOW + workshop) so they can start onboarding activities, but legal/finance need to expedite.

Priya N.: I can fast-track legal review if we get: 1) the exact legal entity name, 2) the PO, and 3) any customer redlines by EOD tomorrow. I can pre-sign off on payment terms to net30 contingent on the PO. If they redline indemnity/liability, that'll add time.

Eli C.: :thinking_face: Alternative: ask for 50% upfront to cover onboarding costs and 50% monthly thereafter. I'll run this with revops — need to know if accounting will accept split payment for this customer.

onboard-bot: Reminder: Customer "Northbridge" onboarding checklist shows blocker: SSO mapping. Ticket #4521.

Maya P.: I'll ping the customer's procurement and request entity + PO. @Jorge can you confirm quote ID and SKU so legal references the right items in the addendum? We must ensure the SKUs map to Dedicated license SKU RDW-DED-PRM.

Jorge R.: Quote ID Q-2026-7889. Confirming SKU RDW-DED-PRM for migrated seats. I'll send the addendum + a short note asking for PO by 2026-04-13 to meet internal timelines.

Priya N.: Once they sign, legal will countersign within 24 hours unless we hit material redlines. If they want monthly billing and their PO stays net15, we will need revops approval before countersigning.

Maya P.: Plan: 1) Jorge sends addendum and requests PO by 4/13. 2) CS starts enablement prep week of 4/22 (workshop materials ready). 3) Legal stands by for EOD redlines. 4) Finance/revops confirms monthly payment path if PO remains net15.

Eli C.: I'll circle with revops and reply in ~8 business hours.

Jorge R.: :thumbsup: Drafting email now. Will include stub SOW to let enablement start.

Maya P.: Thanks — marking thread as at-risk for go-live. If we don't have PO by 4/13 I'll escalate to AM for exec approval and consider a short grace for SSO work to begin.

Priya N.: Acknowledged. I'll standby for entity + PO and will try to expedite review.

Eli C.: Noted. I will update once revops confirms the split payment flow.
